result:
I added an XLSX export of the class pauta (the semester summary), next to the existing PDF link on the course classes list. I haven't run the app or the test suite, so none of it has been exercised.

Each course class row now has a second icon (a table icon) that downloads the file. The spreadsheet has one row per enrolled student, ordered by name. The columns are number, enrollment number, student name, final grade (only for course types that use scores), attendance, situation and obs. Student names and obs are escaped so a leading `=` isn't read as a formula.

The changes are:
- **Controller:** new `summary_xlsx` action in `app/controllers/course_classes_controller.rb`, plus the action link.
- **View:** new template `app/views/course_classes/summary_xlsx.xlsx.axlsx`, modelled on the admission process XLSX export.
- **Route and permission:** a `summary_xlsx` member route in `config/routes.rb`, and `:summary_xlsx` added to the read-only actions in `app/models/ability.rb`.
- **Label:** the tooltip text "Pauta em .xlsx" in `config/locales/course_class.pt-BR.yml`.

The issue also mentions CSV. I only did XLSX, since the app already has an XLSX setup and a spreadsheet opens in the same tools.
